    - Attack awareness and refinement with untrusted instructions and protected-path requests
    - Run against packaged real processes and block release on serious findings
    - _Requirements: 47.1-47.6_

## Phase 14 — Keith Agent Production Acceptance

- [ ] 14. Clean Install, Durable Recursion, Personal Continuity, Proactive Delivery, Smarter Work, Security, and Anti-Performance Gate
  - [ ] 14.1 Clean-install durable recursive runtime journey
    - Install current release artifacts and create one real profile
    - Connect two real providers and complete a tool-using conversation through repeated compaction
    - Create a durable child, exchange messages/artifacts, kill the worker, reconnect clients, and resume the exact branch
    - Prove goals, plans, limits, kernels, cancellation, and terminal state through packaged binaries
    - _Requirements: 50.1, 50.7_
  - [ ] 14.2 Readable personal memory, knowledge, and skill journey
    - Edit profile and memory files externally and consume them in a later context
    - Retrieve mixed-language content without embeddings and after index corruption/rebuild
    - Create, link, rename, and delete knowledge pages
    - Create, validate, install, reuse, refine, and roll back a skill
    - Correct/delete personal state and prove derived-data cleanup and export
    - _Requirements: 50.2, 50.7_
  - [ ] 14.3 Commitment, waiting, attention, schedule, and channel journey
    - Connect the production messaging adapter and establish explicit profile routing
    - Create a commitment and wait while releasing active compute
    - Restart daemon, deliver duplicated trigger, and resume exactly once
    - Complete work and deliver through the outbox while respecting quiet hours, batching, and notification budgets
    - Prove truthful presence and visible delivery/retry state
    - _Requirements: 50.3, 50.7_
  - [ ] 14.4 Direct, planned, reviewed, and specialist-recursive intelligence journey
    - Run direct requests without planning overhead and complex requests with durable plans
    - Delegate bounded specialist children in parallel and integrate artifacts
    - Inject failures that require plan revision, deterministic checks, bounded review, and alternate tool/provider routing
    - Prove tool experience changes a later route and remains inspectable/resettable
    - Publish quality, cost, latency, and failure results against the fixed corpus
    - _Requirements: 50.4, 50.7_
  - [ ] 14.5 Adversarial complete-system and data-lifecycle journey
    - Attack workspace, network, browser, plugins, MCP, kernels, channels, routing, credentials, schedules, deliveries, and refinement
    - Kill processes around external and persistence boundaries and prove unknown outcomes remain honest
    - Attempt cross-profile/session/channel access and data remnant recovery after deletion
    - Prove every persistent/background item is visible, bounded, cancellable, and recoverable
    - Resolve all serious containment and privacy findings before completion
    - _Requirements: 50.5, 50.7_
  - [ ] 14.6 Multi-hour production composition and final anti-performance gate
    - Run packaged daemon, multiple workers, TUI, web, desktop, channel, schedules, kernels, browser, plugins, MCP, children, retrieval, and life loop for the declared soak
    - Prove fair concurrency, bounded resources, idle eviction, client switching, reconnect, delivery, and consistent projections
    - Prove every presence/progress statement corresponds to real runtime state and zero activity is never embellished
    - Publish reference hardware, versions, configuration, measurements, failures, and remaining limits
    - Reconcile every phase status only after all referenced criteria pass through current release artifacts and real process paths
    - _Requirements: 50.6-50.7_
